profile.title: Cynefin.io
profile.canonical_definition: Collaborative wiki for naturalising sense-making concepts, methods, cases, reading and Cynefin Centre programmes.
profile.summary: Cynefin.io is the collaborative project wiki for naturalising sense-making, with concept, method, framework, case and support pages.
profile.why_it_matters: It is the best current route into the project's own semantic network and terminology. As a mutable collaborative wiki, it needs page-level revisions and independent sources for disputed history, priority or effectiveness.
key_distinctions: canonical project vocabulary vs universal authority
open licence vs unrestricted third-party reuse
common_misreadings: the wiki is one authored monograph
editable means unreliable in every respect
canonical for terminology means independent for evaluation
open_checks: record revision IDs for substantial claims
map open and branded content boundaries

sources.title: Cynefin.io — Naturalising Sense-Making wiki
sources.notes: Canonical project wiki and discovery source for current naturalising sense-making terminology, methods and internal cross-links. Pages are collaboratively editable and should be cited with page title, revision and stronger sources for disputed history or efficacy. The wiki states CC BY-SA availability unless a page says otherwise.

sources.title: Anthro-complexity — Cynefin.io
sources.notes: First-party maintained account of anthro-complexity as a body of theory and practice concerning human sense-making and action. Use it for declared scope and vocabulary, not as independent adjudication of contested theoretical claims.

sources.title: Cynefin — Cynefin.io
sources.notes: First-party maintained account of Cynefin as a decision-support framework based on bounded applicability, its domains, dynamics and development. Appropriate for the framework's own definitions; pair with the named papers for historical and scholarly claims.

sources.title: Naturalising sense-making — Cynefin.io
sources.notes: First-party maintained definition of naturalising sense-making, including its use of natural science as a constraint and its links to Cynefin, SenseMaker and anthro-complexity.

sources.title: The Cynefin Company
sources.notes: Canonical first-party source for the organisation's current identity, offers and public library. Use independent sources for evaluative claims about impact or standing.

sources.title: Dave Snowden — The Cynefin Company profile
sources.notes: Canonical first-party source for Dave Snowden's present roles and the organisation's own account of his creation of Cynefin and origination of SenseMaker. It does not independently establish influence, efficacy or priority beyond those declared facts.

sources.title: Complex Acts of Knowing: Paradox and Descriptive Self-Awareness
sources.notes: Official library record for Snowden's article, with bibliographic details and DOI. Use the article itself for arguments and exact terminology.
sources.licence: article licence as stated by host

sources.title: The New Dynamics of Strategy: Sense-making in a Complex and Complicated World
sources.notes: Official library record for the article by Cynthia F. Kurtz and David J. Snowden. The article is a principal scholarly source for early Cynefin dynamics and narrative sense-making.

sources.title: A Leader's Framework for Decision Making
sources.notes: Harvard Business Review record for the article by David J. Snowden and Mary E. Boone. It is a widely circulated practice-facing account of Cynefin; use it alongside earlier and later framework sources rather than as the entire theory.

reuse_note: Preserve source attribution, scope, and review status. Source documents and evidence excerpts are excluded.
